name: Le Sirenuse
insider_take: This legendary clifftop palazzo has been the Sersale family's passion project since 1951, transforming from their summer home into Italy's most coveted coastal retreat.
whats_special: Le Sirenuse sits dramatically perched 300 feet above the Mediterranean in Positano's heart, where every room showcases hand-painted Vietri ceramics and 18th-century Neapolitan antiques. The hotel's Michelin-starred La Sponda restaurant creates magic with 400 flickering candles each evening, while the infinity pool seems to merge seamlessly with the azure horizon below.
pro_tip: Book the Champagne & Oyster Bar sessions at sunset – the terrace offers unobstructed views of Positano's famous cascade of pastel houses, and you'll avoid the daytime cruise ship crowds.
dont_miss: The hotel's private beach club at Arienzo Beach, accessible only by boat or a dramatic cliffside path. Also explore the nearby Villa Cimbrone gardens in Ravello (20 minutes by car), where the "Terrace of Infinity" offers arguably the most spectacular views along the entire Amalfi Coast.
pros: Iconic luxury hotel with stunning Mediterranean views from clifftop location
Legendary Michelin-starred dining and rooftop terrace restaurant
Prime Positano location with direct access to charming village streets
Historic property with timeless Italian elegance and impeccable service
cons: Limited parking availability due to historic village location
